usage: grant-workpaper [-h] --input INPUT --output OUTPUT
                       [--ignore-file IGNORE_FILE]

Local grant allocation and funding workpapers from explicitly reviewed inputs.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --input INPUT
  --output OUTPUT
  --ignore-file IGNORE_FILE
                        CSV of ledger_id,reason naming ledger rows dated
                        outside the ledger period to leave out of every total;
                        each is listed on the workpaper with its reason
